scripts.dev: node scripts/build-ktx2-worker.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,client "tsx watch server/index.ts" "vite --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.build: node scripts/build-ktx2-worker.mjs && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/shared/*.test.ts tests/server/*.test.ts tests/acceptance/*.test.ts tests/client/*.test.ts tests/assets/*.test.ts
scripts.test:assets: node scripts/blender/validate_glb.mjs && node scripts/blender/validate_glb.mjs --glb public/models/scout-v2.glb && node scripts/blender/validate_town_v3.mjs && node scripts/blender/validate_weapons.mjs && node scripts/blender/validate_operator.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run test:assets && npm run build
scripts.town-v2:finish: node scripts/blender/finish_town_v2.mjs --input art/source/town-v2/town-v2-raw.glb --lightmaps art/source/town-v2/town-v2-lightmaps.json --out public/models/environment-v2.glb --tier full --manifest art/source/town-v2/environment-v2-manifest.json && node scripts/blender/finish_town_v2.mjs --input art/source/town-v2/town-v2-raw.glb --lightmaps art/source/town-v2/town-v2-lightmaps.json --out public/models/environment-v2-phone.glb --tier phone --manifest art/source/town-v2/environment-v2-phone-manifest.json
scripts.town-v2: npm run town-v2:generate && npm run town-v2:finish && npm run town-v2:validate
scripts.town-v3:finish: node scripts/blender/finish_town_v3.mjs --input art/source/town-v3/town-v3-raw.glb --lightmaps art/source/town-v3/town-v3-lightmaps.json --out public/models/environment-v3.glb --tier full --manifest art/source/town-v3/environment-v3-manifest.json && node scripts/blender/finish_town_v3.mjs --input art/source/town-v3/town-v3-raw.glb --lightmaps art/source/town-v3/town-v3-lightmaps.json --out public/models/environment-v3-phone.glb --tier phone --manifest art/source/town-v3/environment-v3-phone-manifest.json
scripts.town-v3: npm run town-v3:generate && npm run town-v3:finish && npm run town-v3:validate
scripts.weapons: npm run weapons:generate && npm run weapons:finish && npm run weapons:validate
scripts.operator: npm run operator:generate && npm run operator:finish && npm run operator:validate
scripts.scout-v2: python scripts/blender/scout_textures.py && node scripts/blender/finish_scout_v2.mjs && node scripts/blender/validate_glb.mjs --glb public/models/scout-v2.glb
